curriculum.progression_model: Spiral Curriculum - Skills repeat with increasing complexity

S1.level_description: Foundation building - introducing alphabet, basic sounds, vocabulary

learning_outcomes: Identify and correctly use letters and sounds in Luganda
Form simple words using correct spelling
scenario_examples: Scenario: Introduce yourself with correct pronunciation
Scenario: Spell your name correctly in Luganda
Scenario: Identify sounds in common greetings
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Create a lesson on {topic} at foundational level for S1 students focusing on {core_skill}. Include pronunciation guides, audio cues, and 3 real-life scenarios.

learning_outcomes: Build basic vocabulary for everyday communication
scenario_examples: Scenario: Count items in a marketplace
Scenario: Identify family members in a photo
Scenario: Tell time in Luganda in daily situations
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Generate vocabulary lesson for {topic} with 15-20 core words. Include cultural context, usage examples, and 4 scenario-based practice exercises. Focus on {core_skill}.

learning_outcomes: Listen and respond to simple instructions
scenario_examples: Scenario: Respond appropriately to greetings in different contexts
Scenario: Follow 5 classroom instructions in Luganda
Scenario: Have a simple 3-turn conversation with a speaker
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Create interactive listening and speaking exercises for {topic}. Include audio transcripts, comprehension questions, and 5 scenario-based speaking prompts. Target {core_skill} development.

learning_outcomes: Identify parts of speech (nouns, verbs, pronouns)
Use basic grammar correctly in sentences
scenario_examples: Scenario: Identify nouns and verbs in a short story
Scenario: Change singular nouns to plural in context
Scenario: Use correct pronouns in dialogue
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Create grammar lesson on {topic} with clear rules and examples. Design 6 progressive exercises moving from identification → usage → application in {core_skill}.

scenario_examples: Scenario: Build sentences describing family members
Scenario: Ask and answer questions about daily activities
Scenario: Write negative statements about preferences
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Generate sentence construction exercises for {topic}. Include pattern examples, scaffolded practice (fill-blanks → translate → create), and 4 scenario-based writing tasks.

scenario_examples: Scenario: Read a Luganda folktale and answer who, what, where questions
Scenario: Look at pictures and read matching captions
Scenario: Predict what happens next in a story
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Create culturally relevant short story (80-100 words) for {topic}. Include: original story, vocabulary glossary, 5 comprehension Q&As, and 3 prediction scenarios.

scenario_examples: Scenario: Write 5 sentences describing your family
Scenario: Write a short paragraph about your day
Scenario: Correct spelling and punctuation errors
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Design writing lessons for {topic} with: writing models, step-by-step guides, correction feedback templates, and 4 scaffolded writing scenarios progressing from guided → semi-free → free writing.

scenario_examples: Scenario: Listen to a traditional Luganda story and retell it
Scenario: Learn a traditional song and understand its meaning
Scenario: Guess the answer to traditional riddles
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Create oral literature unit on {topic} including: authentic Luganda text, English translation, cultural context, character analysis, and 5 retelling scenarios for {core_skill} development.

S2.level_description: Intermediate level - expanding grammar complexity, deeper reading, more fluent speaking

scenario_examples: Scenario: Rewrite stories in different tenses
Scenario: Correct agreement errors in passages
Scenario: Use possessives correctly in narrative
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Generate intermediate grammar lesson on {topic} with: rule explanations, comparative examples, 8 progressive drills, and 5 scenario-based application tasks in {core_skill}.

learning_outcomes: Use words accurately in various situations
scenario_examples: Scenario: Order meals at a market using food vocabulary
Scenario: Describe clothing in different contexts
Scenario: Use work-related terms in job interviews
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Create thematic vocabulary unit for {topic} with: 25-30 core terms, usage examples, cultural notes, and 6 scenario-based practice exercises for authentic {core_skill} application.

scenario_examples: Scenario: Discuss a current event with proper turn-taking
Scenario: Ask for clarification when you don't understand
Scenario: Share and defend an opinion respectfully
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Design conversational exercises for {topic} with: dialogue models, audio recordings, comprehension checks, and 5 role-play scenarios requiring {core_skill} in realistic contexts.

learning_outcomes: Read longer texts and extract meaning
Identify main ideas and supporting details
scenario_examples: Scenario: Read a Luganda article and extract 5 key points
Scenario: Identify main idea and 3 supporting details
Scenario: Summarize a story in bullet points
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Create comprehensive reading lesson for {topic} including: 250+ word text, vocabulary pre-teaching, comprehension Q&As (literal, inferential, evaluative), and 4 summarization scenarios.

scenario_examples: Scenario: Write a thank-you letter in Luganda
Scenario: Compose a message explaining your absence
Scenario: Summarize a meeting in writing
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Generate functional writing unit for {topic} with: format models, writing frameworks, revision checklists, and 5 real-world writing scenarios with feedback templates.

learning_outcomes: Identify and explain forms of oral literature
scenario_examples: Scenario: Analyze a Luganda folktale's theme and cultural message
Scenario: Identify character motivations and plot development
Scenario: Perform a story with appropriate intonation and expression
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Create oral literature analysis lesson for {topic} with: original story text, character profiles, theme explanation, cultural notes, and 5 analysis/performance scenarios.

scenario_examples: Scenario: Write a short story inspired by a picture
Scenario: Create a character description
Scenario: Write dialogue between two characters
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Design creative writing unit for {topic} with: writing prompts, story structure guides, vocabulary for description, revision frameworks, and 4 scaffolded creative writing scenarios.

S3.level_description: Advanced level - analyzing complex texts, critical thinking, sophisticated composition

scenario_examples: Scenario: Identify and correct complex sentence errors
Scenario: Convert active sentences to passive voice
Scenario: Use conditionals appropriately in discussions
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Create advanced grammar unit for {topic} with: detailed explanations, comparison with simple forms, 10 progressive exercises, error analysis, and 6 application scenarios in authentic contexts.

learning_outcomes: Write structured compositions with clear organization
scenario_examples: Scenario: Write a 3-paragraph essay on a cultural topic
Scenario: Create a strong thesis and support it with evidence
Scenario: Peer review and revise an essay
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Generate academic writing lesson for {topic} with: essay models, planning worksheets, topic-specific prompts, feedback rubrics, and 4 full essay writing scenarios with revision guides.

learning_outcomes: Read and analyze prose texts deeply
scenario_examples: Scenario: Analyze a Luganda prose excerpt for literary devices
Scenario: Trace character development through a story
Scenario: Write critical interpretation of themes
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Create literature analysis unit for {topic} including: full text or lengthy excerpt, background context, annotation guides, comprehension questions, device analysis prompts, and 5 critical thinking scenarios.

scenario_examples: Scenario: Compare themes in two Luganda texts
Scenario: Analyze how author's style conveys meaning
Scenario: Write analysis supporting interpretation with textual evidence
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Design critical analysis lesson for {topic} with: paired texts, analysis frameworks, comparative questions, evidence-gathering guides, and 4 research-based analysis scenarios.

scenario_examples: Scenario: Analyze poetic devices in a Luganda poem
Scenario: Interpret symbolism and imagery
Scenario: Perform poem with proper intonation and pacing
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Create poetry unit for {topic} with: authentic poems, line-by-line analysis, device identification guides, meaning interpretation questions, performance notes, and 5 analysis/performance scenarios.

learning_outcomes: Express ideas creatively through oral language
scenario_examples: Scenario: Deliver a 3-minute prepared speech
Scenario: Present an argument with supporting evidence
Scenario: Adapt language based on audience
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Design oral presentation unit for {topic} with: speech structures, persuasion techniques, speaker notes, delivery tips, evaluation rubrics, and 4 real-world presentation scenarios.

S4.level_description: Mastery level - integrating all skills, critical analysis, exam preparation, advanced literature

scenario_examples: Scenario: Analyze a Luganda play's dramatic structure
Scenario: Compare techniques in classical vs. modern texts
Scenario: Write critical essay supporting interpretation
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Generate advanced literature unit for {topic} with: complete text or major excerpt, critical frameworks, scholarly context, analysis prompts, comparative questions, and 5 deep textual analysis scenarios.

learning_outcomes: Evaluate and respond to opposing views
scenario_examples: Scenario: Build argument supported by textual evidence
Scenario: Evaluate strength of evidence in passages
Scenario: Write rebuttal to opposing literary interpretation
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Create argumentation unit for {topic} with: argument structures, evidence types, logical fallacies, counter-argument strategies, academic language, and 4 essay writing scenarios requiring skilled argumentation.

learning_outcomes: Write formal and informal texts effectively
scenario_examples: Scenario: Write formal business letter
Scenario: Create comprehensive report
Scenario: Adapt same content for different audiences
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Design professional writing unit for {topic} with: format guidelines, tone conventions, language registers, template examples, feedback checklists, and 5 professional writing scenarios with varying contexts.

scenario_examples: Scenario: Summarize complex text in different lengths
Scenario: Translate Luganda text maintaining meaning
Scenario: Combine info from multiple texts into coherent summary
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Create information processing unit for {topic} with: source materials, summarization frameworks, translation guidelines, synthesis strategies, and 5 comprehensive information transfer scenarios.

scenario_examples: Scenario: Listen to Luganda lecture, take notes, summarize in writing
Scenario: Read text, discuss interpretation, write analysis
Scenario: Integrated exam-style activities combining multiple skills
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Create comprehensive revision unit for {topic} with: mixed-skill activities, timed exercises, full sample exams, answer keys, error analysis, and 6 integrated scenario-based assessment tasks.

scenario_examples: Scenario: Complete capstone project demonstrating all skills
Scenario: Compile portfolio of best work
Scenario: Perform in mock exam conditions
milestones.ai_prompt_template: Design capstone assessment unit for {topic} with: project guidelines, portfolio rubrics, mock exams (multiple formats), detailed answer keys, performance feedback templates, and 3 comprehensive final assessment scenarios.

lesson.description: Interactive lessons for teaching new content

structure.introduction: Hook with scenario or real-world application

lesson.prompt_template: Create a lesson on {topic} for {class_level} in Term {term}. Include: scenario-based introduction, clear explanation, 3 guided examples, 4 practice scenarios covering {core_skill_focus}. Use {language_level} language.

practice.description: Scenario-based practice exercises with immediate feedback
practice.prompt_template: Generate 5 scenario-based practice exercises for {topic} at {class_level}. Each scenario should: present a real Luganda context, require application of {skills}, include 3 difficulty levels, and provide corrective feedback.

quiz.description: Assessments with various question types including scenario-based questions
quiz.prompt_template: Create quiz for {topic} in {class_level} with 15 questions: 5 recall (multiple choice), 5 comprehension (mixed types), 4 scenario-based (real contexts), 1 analysis. Include answer key with explanations.

structure.vocabulary_lists: Themed word banks with usage examples
structure.reference_guides: Grammar rules, pronunciation guides, cultural notes

resource.prompt_template: Create {resource_type} resource for {topic} including: core vocabulary (20-30 items), contextual usage examples, cultural background, visual descriptions, and 3 extension readings for deeper learning.

scenario_qualities: Authentic - Based on real Lugandan life and contexts
Relevant - Connected to student experiences and interests
Progressive - Simple in early terms, complex in later terms
Action-oriented - Requiring active language use, not passive recognition
Cultural - Reflecting Lugandan culture, values, and traditions
Immediate - Focused on practical, immediate language use
scenario_contexts: Family & Home Life (greetings, family roles, daily routines)
Health & Wellness (illness, health advice, wellness practices)

scenario_structures.problem_solving: Present problem → student suggests solutions in Luganda
scenario_structures.role_play: Assigned roles → students act out dialogue/interaction
scenario_structures.case_study: Describe situation → students answer questions about it
scenario_structures.narrative: Story context → students retell, analyze, or continue

ai_prompt_usage_examples.lesson_example: Create lesson on 'Market Negotiations' for S2 Term 1 covering Vocabulary. Include: hook scenario (visiting a market in Kampala), explanation of bargaining phrases, 3 guided dialogue examples, 4 practice scenarios where student negotiates prices, 1 cultural note about local market customs.
ai_prompt_usage_examples.quiz_example: Generate quiz for 'Family Members & Relationships' in S1 Term 1: 5 multiple-choice naming family members, 5 fill-in-blanks with pronouns, 4 scenario questions (e.g., 'Your grandfather visits - how do you greet him?'), 1 cultural knowledge question. Include Luganda answer key.
ai_prompt_usage_examples.practice_example: Create 5 scenario practice exercises for 'Food & Cooking' at S2: Scenario 1 (Ordering at restaurant - reading-based), Scenario 2 (Discussing recipes - speaking), Scenario 3 (Describing meal preparation - writing), Scenario 4 (Reading menu - reading), Scenario 5 (Explaining importance of food culturally - analysis). Each with 3 difficulty levels and feedback.
ai_prompt_usage_examples.resource_example: Make vocabulary resource for 'Animal Names & Characteristics' (S1): List 25 animals in Luganda with English, pronunciation, usage in sentences, cultural significance (herding, hunting, folklore), 5 riddles about animals, visual descriptions for matching activities.

formative_assessment.scenario_based_practice: Students apply skills in realistic Lugandan contexts
formative_assessment.peer_assessment: Students evaluate each other's language use
formative_assessment.self_reflection: Students analyze their own progress and challenges

summative_assessment.scenario_based_exams: Applying skills in complex, integrated scenarios
summative_assessment.oral_performance: Speaking and presentation skills in authentic contexts
summative_assessment.comprehension_tests: Reading and listening with analysis questions
summative_assessment.integrated_projects: Capstone projects combining all four skills

differentiation_strategies.for_advanced_students: Scenario complexity, higher-order thinking tasks, research extensions, peer teaching
differentiation_strategies.for_struggling_students: Scaffolded scenarios, vocabulary pre-teaching, model dialogues, visual supports, extended practice
differentiation_strategies.for_mixed_ability: Tiered scenario difficulty levels, choice in activity format, flexible grouping based on scenarios
